anchor: Link in the guide for 'The Persona Selection Model: Why AI Assistants might Behave like Humans [Excerpts]'
context:
If you would like to read the full paper, it is [here](https://alignment.anthropic.com/2026/psm/) and takes roughly 1 hour and 30 minutes. We have excerpted the _Introduction_ and from _Consequences for AI Development_ through to the end of the AI Welfare section.

_Outlines emerging thinking at Anthropic around different personas that models adopt, and the implications of this for safety and AI welfare_
